India and China Hold LAC Talks in Arunachal Pradesh

Indian and Chinese military commanders held talks along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) in Arunachal Pradesh. The meeting, described as the first core commander level dialogue in the eastern sector, focused on issues related to maintaining peace along the border. The discussions occurred amidst existing tensions, including those in the Takshing area. The talks also took place ahead of a potential visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping to India.
